name: app-console
description: Google Play Console, App Store Connect and AdMob for Claude Code: MCP servers, skills and a CLI. No browser needed.

plugins.name: google-play
plugins.description: Listings, .aab upload, tracks, promote, staged rollouts, reviews and replies, Android vitals, products and search rank.

service_account_file.title: Service account JSON key
service_account_file.description: Google Cloud service account key that was invited in Play Console > Users and permissions. Leave empty to use `appconsole config` instead.

plugins.name: app-store-connect
plugins.description: Versions and review state, listing texts, create version, submit to App Review, release, builds, reviews and responses, sales and search rank.

key_id.title: API key ID
key_id.description: Key ID from App Store Connect > Users and Access > Integrations > App Store Connect API.

issuer_id.title: Issuer ID
issuer_id.description: Issuer ID shown above the list of team keys.

private_key_file.title: Private key (.p8)
private_key_file.description: The AuthKey_<KEY_ID>.p8 file. Leave empty if it is in ~/.appstoreconnect/private_keys.

vendor_number.title: Vendor number (optional)
vendor_number.description: Only for sales reports: App Store Connect > Payments and Financial Reports.

plugins.name: admob
plugins.description: Earnings, eCPM, match and show rate by app, ad unit, country, format, date or ad source, and the list of apps and ad unit ids.

publisher_id.title: Publisher ID (optional)
publisher_id.description: pub-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX, only needed if your Google user has several AdMob accounts. Authorize once with `appconsole admob login`.
